turns.content: State the photoelectric energy balance connecting photon energy, work function, and electron kinetic energy for this metal.
Calculate the photon energy for an incident wavelength of 305 seconds using hc=1240 eV nm.
Determine the work function after treating the electron kinetic energy as 1.77 kelvin.
Write the threshold condition at the maximum wavelength that can still eject an electron.
Calculate that maximum wavelength and compare it with 305 nm.
Check the units and explain physically why the threshold wavelength is longer than the incident wavelength.
